message.content:
Here’s a quick‑fire lineup you can drop straight onto your Friday‑night binge schedule—mixes of classic chills, fresh scares, and mind‑bending dread so there’s something for every mood:

| # | Title & Year | Genre / Tone | Why It Works |
|---|--------------|-------------|---------------|
| **1** | *Halloween* (1978) – slasher | A low‑budget masterpiece that turned jump‑scares into an art form. Perfect if you want pure, relentless terror without too many plot twists. |
| **2** | *A Quiet Place* (2018) – sci‑fi/psychological | Silence is survival here. The tension builds as sound becomes deadly—a great way to keep everyone glued to their seats. |
| **3** | *Get Out* (2017) – social thriller | Sharp satire wrapped in a creepy narrative. Great conversation starter after the credits roll. |
| **4** | *Midsommar* (2019) – folk horror | Daylight doesn’t mean safety when cult rituals run amok. Beautifully unsettling visuals paired with slow‑burn dread. |
| **5** | *It Follows* (2014) – supernatural | An eerie “you’re being followed” premise that feels oddly personal—and it never lets up. |
| **6** | *Hereditary* (2018) – family tragedy meets cosmic horror | If you love a story that turns familiar domestic life upside down, this one will haunt you long after the last frame. |
| **7** | *The Conjuring* (2013) – paranormal investigation | Real‑world folklore meets cinematic suspense. Easy to follow yet genuinely scary. |
| **8** | *Suspiria* (2018) – dance‑school nightmare | Visually striking, musically intense, and full of unnerving atmosphere. Good for those who enjoy style over straightforward gore. |
| **9** | *Us* (2019) – twin doppelgänger twist | Dark humor + body horror makes for a memorable ride through suburban paranoia. |
| **10** | *Evil Dead Rise* (2023) – campy gore | For fans of over-the-top bloodshed and laugh‑at-your-fear moments. |

### Quick Streaming Guide  
*(Check local listings before committing)*  

| Film | Where You Can Watch (as of May 2026) |
|------|-------------------------------------|
| Halloween | Amazon Prime Video (rental/purchase), Hulu (subscription) |
| A Quiet Place | Disney+ (purchase/rent) |
| Get Out | HBO Max (stream) |
| Midsommar | Netflix (sub) |
| It Follows | Apple TV+ (rent) |
| Hereditary | Paramount+ (stream) |
| The Conjuring | Peacock (free tier) |
| Suspiria | Shudder (subscription) |
| Us | AMC+ (stream) |
| Evil Dead Rise | Amazon Prime Video (buy/rent) |

Feel free to mix and match based on how much time you have—or even line them up back‑to‑back for a marathon! Enjoy the frightful fun.
